title: In TIME LAPSE, the shortcut you take on the first loop can get you killed on the third
author: Pretty-Dot6663
selftext:
I built TIME LAPSE for the Base44 × Nitro game jam. In each room, you race to the glowing exit before the timer runs out. On the first loop, you can cut straight across the middle. On the next, a ghost takes that exact shortcut, blade swinging. By the third loop, you have two of your past selves to dodge.

One bug I ran into while building this with Base44’s AI was easy to miss. On loop two, I saw my ghost and thought the replay worked. On loop three, the newest ghost was there, but the first one was gone. The fix was to keep every route recorded in the room and replay them all together.

Once there are three ghosts on screen, can you still spot the one replaying your first route?

[Play TIME LAPSE in your browser](https://app.base44.com/launchpad/hissing-chrono-blade-arena)

replies.author: Pretty-Dot6663
replies.body: Thanks for playing! I’m glad you liked it. I’m a programmer, and I built this game entirely through prompts. Knowing the terminology helped me describe exactly what I wanted the ghosts to do, which meant fewer rounds of back and forth.

replies.author: Guilty_Sherbert_3921
replies.body: That's great! but what tech did you use for making this?

replies.author: Pretty-Dot6663
replies.body: Using prompts in Base44. Three.js handles the 3D graphics, and React handles the menus and in-game HUD. For a full release, even on the web, I’d redesign the HUD. :)
